proof_body:
by
  intro P a
  have h1 : (P - Polynomial.C (P.eval a)).IsRoot a := by
    simp [Polynomial.IsRoot]
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr h1
  have hd : P.derivative.eval a = G.eval a := by
    have h := congrArg (fun p => (Polynomial.derivative p).eval a) hG
    simpa [Polynomial.derivative_mul] using h
  have h2 : (G - Polynomial.C (G.eval a)).IsRoot a := by
    simp [Polynomial.IsRoot]
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr h2
  refine ⟨Q, ?_⟩
  rw [hd]
  linear_combination hG + (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) * hQ
target_source: ∀ (P : Polynomial ℝ) (a : ℝ), ∃ Q : Polynomial ℝ, P = (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) ^ 2 * Q + Polynomial.C (P.derivative.eval a) * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) + Polynomial.C (P.eval a)
